newsitem.title: USA: Spectrian Corp names Bruce Wright CFO.
newsitem.headline: Spectrian Corp names Bruce Wright CFO.

text.p: Spectrian Corp on Thursday announced the appointment of Bruce Wright as executive vice president, finance and administration, and chief financial officer.
For the past six years, Wright has been chief financial officer of Tencor Instruments, a leader in semiconductor inspection and metrology equipment. He is expected to join Spectrian on May 1, 1997.

Prior to Tencor, Wright was chief financial officer of Teknekron Corp, a $250-million diversified high-tech company, and vice president, finance, of Treasure Chest Advertising Company, a printer of newspaper advertising supplements.
Spectrian is an independent supplier of ultra-linear, high-power RF power amplifiers to wireless communication infrastructure manufacturers worldwide.
